description: List envelopes, optionally filtered by status.

status.description: Optional status to filter envelopes by (e.g. 'sent', 'delivered', 'completed', 'voided').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with resultSetSize, totalSetSize, and a list of envelope objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single envelope by its envelope id.

envelope_id.description: The unique id of the envelope.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the envelope object; on failure (envelope not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new envelope, optionally with recipients (signers) and documents.

email_subject.description: Optional email subject line for the envelope.

status.description: Envelope status to create it in (default 'created'); use 'sent' to send immediately.

template_id.description: Optional template id the envelope is based on.

recipients.description: Optional recipients object with a 'signers' list; each signer may include recipientId, name, email, and routingOrder.

documents.description: Optional list of document objects; each may include documentId, name, and pages.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output includes the new envelopeId, status, statusDateTime, and uri.

description: Update the status of an existing envelope.

envelope_id.description: The unique id of the envelope to update.

status.description: The new status for the envelope (e.g. 'sent', 'completed', 'voided').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output includes envelopeId, status, and statusDateTime; on failure (envelope not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the recipients (signers) of an envelope, ordered by routing order.

envelope_id.description: The unique id of the envelope.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output includes a list of signer objects and recipientCount; on failure (envelope not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the documents attached to an envelope, ordered by document order.

envelope_id.description: The unique id of the envelope.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output includes envelopeId and a list of envelopeDocuments; on failure (envelope not found), output contains an error message.

description: List all envelope templates available in the account.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output includes resultSetSize and a list of envelopeTemplates objects.
